body: The repository CI runs pnpm -r --if-present run test:coverage, so this new package is skipped by mise run ci even though focused tests pass. Add the existing vitest run --coverage script so the package tests execute in the standard CI test phase.
author: Codex

replies.body: Added test:coverage using the repository-standard vitest run --coverage command. The composition suite now runs 14/14 green in the standard CI coverage phase.
